responsibility: Declares the analysis_plan helper used by the analyzer engine to make stable interprocedural scheduling decisions. It owns the callgraph postorder/index data used to compare functions for worklist priority and exposes the policy hook that decides whether a given cgraph edge should use call-summary replay versus full interprocedural traversal.
same_name_distinction: Declares the analysis_plan class, its stored ordering data, and the cmp_function/use_summary_p API. Unlike analysis-plan.cc, it does not build the postorder or decide summary use itself; it exposes that planner interface to the rest of the analyzer.
